stories.headline: Ukraine hits Crimean Bridge again
stories.dek: Two dead; a span is reported down in the Kerch Strait. Moscow cites 2,049 drones.
stories.art: Flat side view of the Kerch Bridge with one road span broken into the strait and a small drone above.

stories.headline: Bahrain intercepts Iranian drones
stories.dek: Bahrain reports no damage. US hit Qeshm 6+ times; IRGC says a drone is down.
stories.art: Coastal radar base, a drone breaking apart short of it, and a small island marked with six strike ticks.

stories.headline: Trump lands in Manila for Quad
stories.dek: He met India, Japan and Australia: first Quad summit in 2 years, then Xi and Putin.
stories.art: Airliner over Manila Bay with four small flags: United States, India, Japan, Australia.

stories.headline: PAHO revokes measles-free status
stories.dek: PAHO revokes the US, Mexico and Bolivia. The US logged 5,700 cases and several deaths.
stories.art: Three simple country outlines with a cracked health shield and a small measles spot.

stories.headline: COP31 nations split on fossil exit
stories.dek: Nearly 200 nations in Antalya. Poorer states seek at least $120bn a year to adapt.
stories.art: Sun over a conference hall, an oil barrel with a crack through it, two arrows pulling apart.

stories.headline: China cuts more Canada tariffs
stories.dek: Xi and Carney: China eases tariffs on C$400m of Canadian goods; steel relief stays.
stories.art: Canada and China flags, a container, and a downward arrow on a tariff tag.

stories.headline: UK sanctions settler builders
stories.dek: Miliband names 8 West Bank construction firms and the aid-blocking group Tzav 9.
stories.art: UK crest stamp over a small settlement block and a blocked aid truck.

stories.headline: Settlers kill woman near Jericho
stories.dek: Officials name Fadha Wadha, 72. Ten were hurt. The Israeli army did not comment.
stories.art: Flat village house and olive trees with a single candle; no graphic violence.

stories.headline: Khurelsukh says he will resign
stories.dek: Khurelsukh denies a $25m railway claim and says he will face investigators.
stories.art: Government building, a short rail line, and a figure stepping down from a podium.

stories.headline: Japan scrambles over Russian jets
stories.dek: 2 aircraft entered airspace near Okinoshima. Seoul says planes crossed its ADIZ only.
stories.art: Two fighter silhouettes, a Japan outline, and a thin alert arc over a small island.

stories.headline: Workers clash at Bangladesh plants
stories.dek: Workers want 30,000 taka, up from 12,500. At least 37 factories have shut.
stories.art: Garment factory, a blocked highway, and placards. No crowd portraits.

stories.headline: Africa CDC warns on Congo Ebola
stories.dek: Africa CDC: 11,200 cases and 5,500 deaths in six months, across eight provinces.
stories.art: DRC outline, a medical cross, and a warning triangle. No gore.

stories.headline: GAZA: Strikes kill five, including a child
stories.dek: Anadolu Agency reports five dead, including one child, in strikes across the strip.
stories.art: Small map of the strip with five marks. No bodies.

stories.headline: HORMUZ: Three ships on fire in the strait
stories.dek: One is an LNG carrier and one a supertanker holding over 2 million barrels.
stories.art: Narrow strait with three ships, one trailing a flat smoke plume.

stories.headline: KYIV: Strikes shut two Dnipro bridges
stories.dek: Klitschko: North and South bridges shut. Seven killed; 50,000 lose power.
stories.art: River with two bridge icons closed, and a dark power line.

stories.headline: PRAGUE: Two trains collide and injure 46
stories.dek: BBC reports 46 people hurt in the Czech capital. No death toll was given.
stories.art: Two flat train engines nose to nose on one track.

stories.headline: SIBERIA: An-12 crash kills all 19 aboard
stories.dek: A Russian Air Force transport went down near Kemerovo. All 19 people died.
stories.art: Four-engine cargo plane silhouette and a taiga treeline.

stories.headline: GOPALGANJ: Mob burns a police station
stories.dek: Awami League activists also burn BNP MP S M Jilani's house. Police used tear gas.
stories.art: Small police station with a flame shape and a roadblock.

stories.headline: CUPERTINO: Apple Pay and App Store fail
stories.dek: Apple blames an internal update, not a hack, for outages on four services.
stories.art: Four app tiles greyed out under a simple apple mark drawn as a flat fruit.

stories.headline: PARIS: Public-sector unions strike on pay
stories.dek: AFP: 5.8 million workers were called out after talks with PM Lecornu failed.
stories.art: Row of public buildings and a placard. Do not imply a counted march.

stories.headline: BELGRADE: New parliament sits after vote
stories.dek: Student List holds 140 of 250 seats and has 90 days to name a government.
stories.art: Parliament semicircle with 140 seats filled in one colour.

stories.headline: KIGALI: Five EU states plan a return hub
stories.dek: About 100 rejected asylum seekers from 2027. Spain's Sanchez condemns the plan.
stories.art: Small building between EU and Rwanda flags, labelled as a plan not an open camp.

stories.headline: BRUSSELS: EU sanctions Wildberries' Kim
stories.dek: Tatyana Kim's assets are frozen. She and the Kremlin deny any military role.
stories.art: Shopping-bag mark with a freeze stamp. No portrait.

stories.headline: GENEVA: 128 states debate killer robots
stories.dek: Talks opened Monday and continue. At least 50 want a treaty; US, Russia and Israel do not.
stories.art: Round table and a drone icon with a human hand on a switch.

stories.headline: MUSCAT: Oman and Iran discuss sea lanes
stories.dek: Their foreign ministers met Tuesday on shipping corridors and on restarting talks.
stories.art: Two dhows in a shipping lane between simple coastlines.

stories.headline: MEXICO: Sheinbaum asks Xi for closer ties
stories.dek: She names technology, farming, water and tourism in Tuesday's meeting with Xi.
stories.art: Mexico and China flags over four small icons: chip, wheat, drop, suitcase.

stories.headline: MANILA: Japan offers ASEAN its oil stocks
stories.dek: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi says the reserves can be used in a supply crisis.
stories.art: Oil tanks and a ring of small ASEAN flags.

stories.headline: INDIA: Rupee gains 43 paise to 93.51
stories.dek: Traders cite softer crude and foreign inflows. A stronger dollar capped the rise.
stories.art: Rupee mark and a short upward sparkline ending at 93.51.

stories.headline: DELHI: Court hears 48 voter-roll questions
stories.dek: Rahul Gandhi and the INDIA bloc filed them. A fuller hearing is set for 9 December.
stories.art: Court columns and a ballot roll with a question mark.

stories.headline: ANDHRA: Coast on alert for Cyclone Akvan
stories.dek: Home Minister Anitha tells collectors and police to prepare and warns fishermen.
stories.art: Bay of Bengal spiral and a fishing boat pulled onto a beach.

stories.headline: CHENNAI: Dhoni retires; named IPL mentor
stories.dek: On the 2027 retention deadline he ends a spell that began with a $1.5m buy in 2008.
stories.art: Cricket bat laid flat beside a mentor whistle. No likeness.

stories.headline: ISTANBUL: State takes Sozcu TV off air
stories.dek: Authorities detained four executives and named a trustee to run the channel.
stories.art: Television set with a blank screen and a trustee stamp.

stories.headline: INDIA: Bilkis Bano to fight convicts' bail
stories.dek: She says the Supreme Court did not hear her before the 28 October bail order.
stories.art: Scales of justice and a folded statement. No portrait.

stories.headline: ANTALYA: Britain signs a polluter levy
stories.dek: The Cop31 statement asks small targeted levies on polluting sectors to fund action.
stories.art: Smokestack with a small coin dropping into a climate fund box.

stories.headline: ANTALYA: Pacific states want IPCC by 2028
stories.dek: With African and European delegates, they want the science before the next stocktake.
stories.art: Pacific island outline beside a calendar marked 2028 and a thin science report.

stories.headline: BERLIN: US sets Ukraine talks for Thursday
stories.dek: Axios: Witkoff and Kushner will meet Ukrainian and European officials on guarantees.
stories.art: Calendar page showing Thursday and two empty chairs. Meeting has not happened.

stories.headline: KUALA LUMPUR: France, Malaysia sign pact
stories.dek: Macron's visit brings defence and energy deals plus limited raw rare-earth exports.
stories.art: France and Malaysia flags over a small rare-earth rock and a handshake.

stories.headline: SIGUIRI: Guinea holds 1,263 in gold sweep
stories.dek: The ban covers foreign and local miners. Burkina Faso and Mali object to treatment.
stories.art: Gold pan crossed out and a row of simple custody marks. No faces.

stories.headline: SINGAPORE: Brazil win 7-0; Vinicius nets 3
stories.dek: He completed the hat-trick in 21 minutes. Endrick, Estevao and Rayan also scored.
stories.art: Scoreboard 7-0 and a ball. No player likeness.

stories.headline: MANILA: Day-five protests as Trump meets
stories.dek: Demonstrators oppose the Iran war and a planned AI hub near the capital.
stories.art: Plaza with placards in front of a low skyline. No portraits.
